class.name: GDCubismMotionLoader
class.brief_description: Legacy motion JSON to Animation resource loader.
class.description: Converter for [code].motion3.json[/code] resources. Reads at most 4 MiB and validates the motion schema, segment widths and declared counts before conversion. Uses [code]Meta.Fps[/code] for the Animation step and preserves linear and cubic parameter curves, including the SDK restricted-Bezier evaluation mode. Stepped handles still use infinity, inverse steps add a key offset, and non-parameter curves are skipped. Do not treat its output as lossless native Cubism playback. Use [CubismModelImporter] with [CubismModel2D] for the supported native-motion path; [member CubismMotionDescriptor.animation] is not required for that path.
